summary: Digital Twin simulation stress-tests user's account graph and identifies critical exposure chains.

attack_vectors.description: 7 accounts lack 2FA and are vulnerable to credential stuffing attacks using leaked password databases.
Password group 'alpha_reuse' shared across 3 accounts. Compromising one gives access to all.
Primary email controls password resets for 7 dependent accounts. HIGH RISK: No 2FA on email!

response.ai_analysis: Found 3 attack vectors with 79% average success probability. Priority: enable 2FA on all accounts, eliminate password reuse, and review excessive permissions.
recommendations: Enable 2FA on all accounts, especially email and finance
Use unique passwords for every account (use a password manager)
